trial_court: Special Mobile Magistrate (Sub Judge), Srinagar, file No.06/2019
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent entered into marital tie in 2005; twin female issues born; prior to marriage with respondent, petitioner had married Shabeena who left for her heavenly abode in 1997 due to illness; petitioner executed divorce deed on 06.07.2019 and communicated same to respondent through registered post; respondent filed complaint under Section 12 of J&K Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance granted under one provision can be taken note of, adjusted or set off while granting the same under other provision.
legal_principles.held: Whether the maintenance granted by way of interim maintenance by the Revisional Court is exorbitant and has been granted without taking note of the fact that apart from two children out of the marriage between the petitioner and the respondent, the petitioner has two more major children of the previous marriage to take care of.

legal_principles.principle: Proceedings under different provisions entitling the aggrieved party to invoke both or either of them are two independent provisions.
legal_principles.held: Whether the proceedings under Section 488 Cr.P.C. (125 of Central Cr.P.C.) and Section 20 of the D.V.Act are two independent provisions entitling the aggrieved party to invoke both or either of them?
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Criminal Procedure — Section Y

outcome.final_order: Order dated 31.01.2020 passed by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Srinagar set aside the order of Special Mobile Magistrate (Sub Judge), Srinagar dated 29.07.2019
